tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background (galvanized steel). Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, gauge plate, report paper. Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Brushed zinc: header, bottom bar, nameplate. Apply the brushed grain only here. Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary buttons, inputs, plates). At least 3:1 on ground, surface and panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, mark ring, gauge needle.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono labels. Passes 4.5:1 on ground, surface and panel.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Actions only: primary button, capture button, focus ring, the anode square in the mark. Never a severity, never decoration.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cobalt.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links. Dark theme uses a lighter cobalt so links pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: Motion only: the current pulse that runs along a corrosion outline while measuring.

tokens.name: photo-mark
tokens.usage: Corrosion outline and blueprint corner marks drawn over photos.

tokens.name: sev-1
tokens.usage: S1 Cosmetic marker fill. Text on it: on-sev-1. Always shown with its S1 label.

tokens.name: on-sev-1
tokens.usage: Text on sev-1.

tokens.name: sev-2
tokens.usage: S2 Developing marker fill. Text on it: on-sev-2.

tokens.name: on-sev-2
tokens.usage: Text on sev-2.

tokens.name: sev-3
tokens.usage: S3 Significant marker fill. Text on it: on-sev-3.

tokens.name: on-sev-3
tokens.usage: Text on sev-3.

tokens.name: sev-4
tokens.usage: S4 Critical marker fill and the escalate button border. Text on it: on-sev-4.

tokens.name: on-sev-4
tokens.usage: Text on sev-4.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text of the escalate action and error messages on ground or surface.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Rust is a measurement, not a guess.
styles.usage: Marketing and empty-state headlines. One per screen at most.

styles.name: grade
styles.usage: The grade on a nameplate. Nothing else is this size in mono.

styles.name: marker
styles.usage: Text inside a severity pipe marker, uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, breadcrumbs, nav labels, uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a readout or between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, corner-mark inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on phone; header item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on phone; plate padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Touch target height for buttons; page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Count plates, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, cards, photo frames, nameplates. Engineered, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Capture button, account plate.

tokens.name: dur-marker
tokens.usage: Severity marker slides in from the left.

tokens.name: dur-outline
tokens.usage: Corrosion outline draws onto the photo.

tokens.name: dur-needle
tokens.usage: Gauge needle sweeps, overshoots once and settles.

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: One lap of the current pulse along the outline while measuring.
